name: Where Power Comes From
_what: Info film, two halves: the power sources as told publicly (lattice, nanite ordered and wild, the Veil, metaphysical craft, the body), then what an arc is and the greater arcs by their first-stage publicFace only. No Sovereigns, no hidden truths, no figures. Unlocked always.
_canon: EXESA_o1.md III (four sources in two pairs, a pure thing and its approximation; lattice wants dense ground; ordered and wild one source in two states; the conversion argument between four traditions, nobody calling it a war, who decides what a place is for; wild thrives in the gaps; the Veil, the Void as absence of the rules, subtraction, thin ground; metaphysical needs meaning and thin apparatus; meaning gathers where people are), VI (great figures at their own work, most never heard of you); power_systems_o1.md (a craft draws on one or a mix; magic is structured nanite spent into purpose; goes wild, river and wheel; wild processed back, a reason to fight over a spent yard; Veil anti-power to lattice; metaphysical asks everything of the practitioner; body asks nothing, thin ground is quiet ground); tradition_profiles_f1.json powerSources[precursor].oneLine/theCraft (grammar; queried not commanded); power_cosmology_f1.json theConversion.breakers/orderers; ARCS_o1.md first rule and PLAYERS_GUIDE_f1.md arcs section (turn without you; proximity decides; resolve completely, permanent; wakes; the weather at one moment; an arc you ignore does not wait politely); greater_arcs_f1.json arcs[].name and stages[0].publicFace; locations_f1.json descriptionSeed for the_service_ways, the_spent_yard, the_kept_shrine, the_grindstone. lines: Every craft draws on something.
There are four sources, in two pairs: a pure thing, and a human approximation of it.
The lattice is the old apparatus, still running, strongest where the works lie thick.
It is queried, and nobody commands it. It answers those who learn its grammar.
Under the Gearlands, something in the old tunnels is still running its original errand. The Enginewrights are careful not to interrupt it.
Nanite is the made copy.
What the world calls magic is ordered nanite spent into purpose: asked, answering, scattering.
It does not run out. It goes wild, like a river used up turning a wheel: still there, no longer doing what you asked.
Wild nanite thrives in the gaps, where nobody keeps a place.
Gathered, it can be ordered again, which is a reason to fight over a spent yard.
The Rootkin and the Churnfolk break ordered nanite back to wild. The Enginewrights and the Seraphic Orders order it again.
Nobody calls it a war. It is about who decides what a place is for.
The Veil is the pure absence, and its craft wants thin ground. Past it lies the Void: the absence of the rules themselves.
Veil craft is subtraction.
Where the lattice is weak, the Veil is thin. Thinning one strengthens the other.
Metaphysical craft is the Veil reached from the human side: mind past matter. It asks everything of the one who practises it.
It needs meaning to work on and thin apparatus to work through.
The places thick with meaning are usually thick with lattice too.
Meaning gathers where people are. A village has it by being lived in.
A place that empties loses it.
And the body: breath, the hand and its years. It asks nothing of the ground, and it is best where the lattice is worst.
At the Grindstone, body-workers come to see what real use does to a person.
The arcs turn without you, and which one you meet depends on where you stand.
Each resolves completely, one way or another, and what it leaves is permanent.
New arcs rise from what is left.
The Poles Pull.
Each Reach is leaning harder into its own extreme. Travellers notice the edges of the world getting sharper.
What Wakes Beneath.
Deep sites report faint stirrings, far apart from one another.
The Second Manifestation.
A new domain has manifested where none was. Scholars argue whether it is the first of many.
The Green Schism.
In the Deepwood the Moot is arguing, slowly, whether to seal the wood from humankind. The Rootbound are gaining ground.
The Long Petition.
People are asking for more than they used to, a word put in, a door held open, and most of the asking is being answered.
The Glare.
More is said in public than it used to be. People confess before they are asked, and the boards are full.
The Long Sleep.
More people are sleeping longer. Nobody is sick. They are resting, and waking a little further away.
The Widening.
People who part are not meeting again. Nobody decided it. The roads just got longer.
Out on the roads, a great many people are leaning on these already. Most of them have never heard of you.
Each is pushing on something, and being pushed back. So are you, and an arc you ignore does not wait politely.
This is the weather at one moment.
A season from now it will not be the same.
